name: My Melody & Kuromi
summary: Two adorable shop owners - a baker and a candy maker - must team up despite their differences to save their hometown.

name: Fox News Tonight
summary: Fox News Tonight will air live as an interim show helmed by rotating FOX News personalities.

name: Miriam Margolyes in New Zealand
summary: Determined to seize the day, National Treasure Miriam Margolyes leaps across the ditch and dives headfirst into a new country, on a fresh journey full of surprising contradictions, new challenges, unexpected lessons and revealing stories.

name: Vestiaires
summary: In the locker room, Stéphane welcomes the new members of the swimming club. Pierre, the team coach, unveils the club's new official outfit. Reactions are mixed. Everything gets tougher when it comes time to choose their rallying cry.

name: It's All Geek to Me
summary: It's All Geek to Me is a television program created and that is broadcast on the Science Channel. It first aired on May 18, 2007. To describe it, Pogue writes in his blog, "What is it? Think 'funny cooking show'—except instead of whipping up food, I'll be whipping up technology projects!"

name: Fake Love
summary: The female CEO took a fancy to the male bartender, and the two had a passionate night. Si Nan offered to support Bai Zi Hao with a high salary to help him with his sister's medical expenses. In fact, her real purpose was to transplant his kidney to her brother, who suffered from uremia. Bai Zi Hao also pretended to be a prey to be approached by a rich woman. The sister who suffered from leukemia was actually his childhood sweetheart, An Ran. After An Ran met Si Nan's rich brother, she didn't want to live a poor life with the bartender anymore. She lied that she had leukemia to make him give up. At the same time, Si Nan and Bai Zi Hao became more emotionally involved as they spent time together and got along. He wanted to stop the loss in time and was ready to run, but found out that An Ran was with Si Nan's brother. All the scams were revealed.

name: Listen to the Earth
summary:
"Listen to the Earth" is a disaster prevention series where children and adults alike are encouraged to give serious thought to the topic. Japan is often struck by various natural disasters, with many people having lost their lives in the Great Hanshin and Great East Japan Earthquakes. Both children and adults alike should consider how to protect themselves in such disasters by understanding how these natural disasters occur, and practice preventive measures.
This series aims to foster correct understanding of disasters by demonstrating the damage they can cause, and how they occur in the first place. The audience can consider what measures to take to protect themselves and their family if they are ever in a disaster situation while learning from specialists and taking part in quizzes.

previousepisode.name: How to Stay Safe in a Flood

name: To Heal The Heart
summary: Based on the life of An Katsumasa, a Korean psychiatrist who lived in Japan, this series tells the story of one doctor's capacity for love. When the Great Hanshin Earthquake strikes Japan in January 1995, protagonist An Kazutaka springs into action to care for the mental health of others, even though he is a victim himself. He listens to the concerns of earthquake survivors, empathizes with their pain, and eventually becomes a pioneer researcher of PTSD (Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder) in Japan. An's deep bond with his wife, who stays by his side through many hardships, is also depicted, as are the heartfelt ties he forms with his patients.

name: Wo Yang De Xiao Bai Lian Shi Jing Quan Tai Zi Ye
summary: Jiang Ci You had just married Yan Feng, but he eloped abroad with her best friend Xia Ling. Having been betrayed twice, Jiang Ci You kept a pretty boy named Bo Jin Xiu. She didn't know that this pretty boy was the famous prince of Beijing. Bo Jin Xiu was willing to be her canary for the past two years. Jiang Ci You's husband came back and wanted to break up with her. Bo Jin Xiu decisively restored his identity and took steps to marry her.

name: Who Saw the Peacock Dance in the Jungle?
summary: Collegiate Komugi Yamashita lives with her retired policeman father, having lost her mother early on. But then her father is murdered, leaving only a letter cryptically naming a certain person as innocent should he ever be arrested or prosecuted. Learning the suspect is the son of a criminal executed 22 years ago, Komugi seeks the help of a lawyer Matsukaze named in the letter. But Matsukaze has never had any contact with Komugi's father. So the two go in search of the shocking truth.

name: She Rides the Wind
summary: The soon-to-be CEO of the Qin Corporation, Qin Nan, unexpectedly discovers her husband, Luo Sen, having an illicit affair with her father's secretary, Tong Qian. This betrayal drives her to the brink of despair. After being reborn, she resolves to uncover the truth behind the Qin Corporation's precarious situation. To solidify her position in the company, Qin Nan hires Fu Yunlan, the Chief Technology Officer of Simulation Cabin. With Fu Yunlan's help, she repeatedly thwarts the traps set by Tong Qian and Luo Sen. Amid the turmoil, an unexpected romance begins to blossom.Qin Nan uncovers evidence of Tong Qian's embezzlement and successfully forces her out, compelling Luo Sen, her accomplice, to flee in disgrace. However, she soon discovers the real reason Fu Yunlan joined the company: to investigate the truth behind his sister Fu Yunya's tragic death.Through their joint efforts, the criminal schemes of Zhao Zicheng, a business partner of the Qin Corporation, come to light. It is revealed that he sexually assaulted Fu Yunya, ultimately driving her to take her own life. Fu Yunlan's quest for revenge places him in grave danger, prompting Qin Nan to risk her life to save him. Together, they bring Zhao Zicheng to justice.Just when it seems everything has finally settled, Qin Nan is betrayed and imprisoned by her best friend, Xue Minmin, who is revealed to have been part of Tong Qian's long-laid schemes. In a life-and-death confrontation, Fu Yunlan takes a desperate risk, thwarting Tong Qian and Xue Minmin's plans but vanishing from Qin Nan's life in the process.Where did he go? After Qin Nan's countless fruitless searches, one quiet afternoon, he reappears before her once more...

name: Snake Boss
summary:
Former pastry chef Julia Baker, aka Snake Boss, is a fearless snake charmer whose face-to-face encounters with Queensland's most dangerous reptiles are a regular day in the office. From uncovering deadly eastern brown snakes inside children's bedrooms to removing them off rooftops, this brand new series will follow Julia as she visits the homes of Brisbane residents to remove these unwanted slithering visitors.

Brisbane is one of the most competitive places in the world for snake catchers and Julia Baker is one of just a handful of women in Australia relocating snakes for a living. Her foray into the snake catching industry started with a bucket list, and among the many bold goals she successfully ticked off, her greatest passion that remained was her love for snakes – in particular, the venomous species. And so this thrill seeker turned her passion into her profession, even recruiting her Scottish partner, Johnny Gallacher as her apprentice.

Julia has made it her mission to help people understand snakes and not fear them. Follow her and her snake catching team, Johnny and their Jack Russell terrier, Bonnie on every slithery twist and turn as they rescue Brisbane's ophidiophobic residents (and face some of their own phobias) in Snake Boss.

name: The Otome Heroine's Fight for Survival
summary: Orphaned by a monster attack on her village, young Alicia spends three horrid years in an orphanage before finally running away. When she flees, however, Alicia has a violent encounter with an older woman hell-bent on killing her. During their tussle, she comes into contact with a strange crystal that bestows upon her a wealth of knowledge, transforming her from an innocent child into a cool and calculated planner. Now aware that she was meant to be the protagonist of an otome game and disgusted with her supposed fate, Alicia decides to take matters into her own hands and become strong—by any means necessary. Using her newfound knowledge, and with some help from a stranger she meets in the woods, she learns to survive by herself in a world far too harsh and unforgiving for a girl her age. Ready or not, she's determined to carve her own path.

name: The Big Dry
summary: The Luangwa Valley in Zambia is one of Africa's last great wildernesses. A rich mosaic of ebony forests and grassy plains, it's home to a vast array of colourful species including carmine-bee-eaters, hyenas, lions, vultures, crocodiles and insects such as praying mantis. This series follows the challenges the valley's wildlife must overcome during the long dry season as they await the life-giving rains.

name: Dinner Club
summary: The Swiss 3-Michelin-star chef Andreas Caminada embarks on a culinary journey to six different countries with six German-speaking celebrities, including actress Karoline Herfurth. In each episode, Caminada and one of the participants go in search of classic dishes, unusual ingredients and unique culinary experiences. At the end, the respective duo prepares a dinner for all the guests of the dinner club, bringing home the flavors and drinks tasted on the trip, along with the associated adventures and extraordinary stories behind each dish.

name: Patika
summary: Pharmacy Norbert Polacsek is playing at the wedding with the new band of the former beat musician, Old Gold. She doesn't know yet that her Swiss aunt, Lydia, wants to buy the family pharmacy.

name: MLB Network Presents
summary: MLB Network Presents is an original series of documentaries and access-driven profiles. Launched in January 2015, MLB Network Presents has produced programs covering many subjects across baseball, including the Emmy-nominated "The Story of Billy Bean" as well as "Holy Cow! The Story of Harry Caray," ".406," "56: The Streak," "The Bird," "The Colorful Montreal Expos" and "The Nasty Boys: The 1990 Cincinnati Reds."

name: Australian Open Tennis - Pre-Show
summary: Wide World of Sports presents the Australian Open 2025, live from Melbourne Park. Join Tony Jones along with the expert team for all the reviews, previews, interviews, highlights, opinions and topical issues. Live play from 11:00AM AEDT.

name: Australian Open Tennis - Late Night
summary: Wide World of Sports presents the 2025 Australian Open, live from Melbourne Park. Join host James Bracey with the expert team for all the action as the live coverage continues.

name: Clevatess
summary: One of the Lords of Dark Beasts, Clevatess's reign shatters when he revives a hero he personally slayed and adopts an orphaned humanoid baby—the last hope to save a dying world. Now bound together, what fate awaits this unlikely trio?

previousepisode.name: The Millennium of a Dark Beast Lord

name: Virgin Punk
summary: The story follows Ubu, a young woman who finds herself living the dangerous life of a bounty hunter. As she grapples with her inner turmoil, she becomes entangled in a world filled with chaos and the desires of the powerful and eccentric individuals around her.

name: The Muse of Section E
summary: Section E is a notorious high school class full of mischief-loving male troublemakers. When Jay-Jay transfers into the class, becoming the only girl in Section E, her new classmates immediately begin to target her with cruel practical jokes and schemes – hoping to force her to quit. But the feisty, fearless, and independent-minded Jay-Jay refuses to play along. She soon shows the boys that she can give as good as she gets. The devilishly handsome class president Keifer  resolves to use his charms to bring her guard down. But this plan begins to unravel as Cupid arrives on the scene. And a further wrinkle in Keifer's plan appears when their aloof classmate Yuri (Rabin Angeles) also begins to develop a soft spot for Jay-Jay. Does Jay-Jay have what it takes to survive the Section E ordeal – and will the pull of romance prove too strong for her would-be tormentors?

name: Aap Ke Aa Jane Se
summary: A love story between a 42 year old middle class, conservative single mother, Vedika and a 24 year old irresponsible, maverick, Sahil, from a traditional, super rich business family.

name: Ye Yan
summary: Fang Xin Yan was saved by the domineering boss. She made a deal with Jiang Ji Chun and lurked around his nephew to obtain information for him in exchange for clues about her family's murder. During this period, she was moved by the Jiang Ming Langs's gentleness and got involved in the fight between uncle and nephew, and the boss was already in love. As the clues slowly surfaced, it turned out that the real murderer had been hiding around her for a long time.

name: Born Too Soon
summary: Documentary series following the lives of the families, babies, and staff in the busy newborn intensive care unit in Cork University Maternity Hospital.

name: Dr Karl's How Things Work
summary: Dr Karl lifts the lid on how some of Australia's best loved products are made, stepping behind factory lines to uncover the intricate workings of some of our most productive manufacturing plants.

name: Kapitan Petko Voyvoda
summary: Captain Petko Vojvoda is a Bulgarian historical drama series that chronicles the life and struggles of Petko Kiryakov, a 19th-century freedom fighter and defender of Bulgarian and Balkan independence. The series portrays his battles against Ottoman oppression, his leadership of a militia, and his dedication to justice and the liberation of his people. It highlights themes of patriotism, sacrifice, and resilience in the face of adversity.

name: The Offseason
summary: Follows 11 NWSL players as they spend two weeks in Miami training, living together, and providing uncensored access into their personal lives, rivalries, and on-field journey.

name: Auf hoher See
summary: A sailor is murdered on a freighter of the Swiss merchant navy. Inspector Aurélie travels to Cape Town and is supposed to bring the main suspect Florian home. But he protests his innocence and looks for his girlfriend Julia, who was traveling incognito as a passenger. On the high seas, Aurélie tries to uncover the truth.

name: Playing Gracie Darling
summary:
Playing Gracie Darling is set in a place where everyone knows each other, secrets are buried deep, and where being different is impossible to hide.

When Joni was 14, her best friend Gracie Darling disappeared during a séance and hasn't been seen since.

Twenty-seven years on, Joni is a child psychologist and has never forgiven herself for Gracie's disappearance.

Joni is haunted by her past when she receives a startling call from her childhood friend Jay, now a local cop, alerting her that another Darling girl has disappeared during a seance.

name: Eat The Invaders
summary: Host Tony Armstrong - with the help of scientists, land carers, an artist and a chef - will attempt to turn our unwanted ecological trash into desirable culinary gold, in a provocative attempt to Eat the Invaders.

name: The First 48: Room Full of Lies
summary: Enhanced episodes of "The First 48," with bonus content and never-before-seen scenes.

name: Thomas Jefferson
summary: Thomas Jefferson is widely considered the patron saint of America's most sacred beliefs. He is the central figure in the story of American democracy and when he penned the Declaration of Independence nearly 250 years ago, he personally inspired a revolution of self-governance around the world. More so than John Adams, Alexander Hamilton or even Abraham Lincoln, it was Jefferson's "revolution of ideas" that laid the groundwork for America's founding and success. As our 3rd president, Jefferson doubled the size of the country and inspired a western expansion that turned a fledgling nation into an empire. Jefferson's image as an American deity would be almost perfect… were it not for slavery. Although his immeasurable contributions to American freedom and growth have been well documented, the complexities of his relationship with slavery, which include a decades-long sexual relationship with an enslaved woman and the children who came from it, have remained largely misrepresented in the popular American narrative. THOMAS JEFFERSON is a 6×60 premium documentary series and the first of its kind to take an objective and comprehensive approach to the truly remarkable and surprising story of an American icon.

name: Hell For You
summary: Seeking revenge after being framed for murder 14 years ago, Sachiko changes her appearance and infiltrates a popular influencer's home as a babysitter.

name: True Crime Presents
summary: A collection of true crime documentaries that cover a range of real-life offences and notorious offenders.

name: Rising from the Ashes
summary: Xu Cheng is a full-time housewife whose husband, Lu Yan, is an attending physician at a private hospital. They have been married for five years, and they have an adorable daughter named Lu Jiajia. One year ago, Xu Cheng started having trouble sleeping, which is getting serious day after day. The occasional hallucination has also caused her to hurt herself and others. However, a car accident brings a change to this once-perfect marriage. Lu Yan, whose car is now in the lake water, is fortunately enough to be saved by some passerby. Xu Cheng, on the other hand, is missing.

name: Just Wanna Be With You
summary: The Cangyun Goddess Jiang Zhiyu and the young tanuki from the Li clan, Jiang Jinghuai, fell in love after getting to know each other. However, due to their difference in social status, their relationship was opposed by Nangong Xiao, the leader of the Cangyun clan. He set a trap to turn their love into hatred. Yet, as the two continued to be entangled with each other, they gradually uncovered the truth. Their genuine love resolved the conflict and ultimately saved the world.

name: Cold Justice: Inside the Episode
summary: Each one-hour episode of Cold Justice: Inside the Episode features never-before-seen details about one investigation previously chronicled on COLD JUSTICE. Every story has behind-the-scenes facts, insights from Kelly Siegler, and often jaw-dropping allegations that hit the cutting room floor the first time around. Now, these special episodes bring those facts to life.

name: Chidiya Udd
summary: The series revolves around Seher, a resilient 20-year-old from Rajasthan, who dares to dream beyond the confines of her circumstances. Fueled by ambition and a determination to redefine her destiny, Seher journeys to Mumbai, the city of dreams, but soon discovers its darker, grittier side. She dreams of becoming the best prostitute in Mumbai's infamous red light district, Kamathipura. However, her journey isn't that easy. Seher has stepped into Qadir Khan's den and now its a fight to survive. Will Seher fulfil her dreams and fight against the King of Kamathipura?

name: Lockerbie: The Bombing of Pan Am 103
summary:
CNN Original Series Lockerbie: The Bombing of Pan Am 103 tracks the mysterious circumstances behind the deadliest terror attack on the United States before 9/11.

This gripping and emotional series examines the 1988 bombing of Pan Am flight 103 over Lockerbie, Scotland resulting in the death of 270 people, including 190 Americans. The series features heartrending interviews with Lockerbie residents and family members of the passengers who detail their personal experiences of the tragic event. It deftly tracks the complex web of theories that emerged during the global investigation that followed, and the unprecedented trial that played out on the world stage. Though a conviction was upheld in 2000, questions remain about those responsible for one of the most extreme terrorist acts on the United States in history.

Weaving together poignant testimony from family members of the Pan Am 103 passengers and exclusive first-hand analysis from investigators, intelligence officers and other key witnesses who have not spoken until now, Lockerbie is the definitive telling of the 1988 tragedy and the ongoing search for conclusive answers on who is responsible.

name: Wynne & Joanna: All at Sea
summary: Wynne & Joanna: All at Sea follows Wynne Evans and Joanna Page as the duo embark on a fun-filled journey along the Welsh coastline. Fuelled by their friendship, and shared passions of the sea, food and love of adventure, in each episode we'll join the pair on board as they explore the spectacular Welsh coastline by sea. In this heart-warming series, they'll discover everything from secret coves to seafood recipes, famous ports to fabulous people and we'll get a sneak peek into the lives of two of Wales' most beloved stars.

name: Colin and Justin's Sub-Zero Reno
summary:
Colin and Justin's Sub-Zero Reno puts Colin and Justin in completely new renovation territory. Having purchased a dilapidated cabin on a picturesque blue lake — beautiful in summer, but harsh in the cold months - the couple have their work cut out for them. They must transform an ugly duckling property (and former storage facility for their many projects) into their dream home amidst the unforgiving Canadian winter, where temperatures plummet to minus 40 degrees Celsius. 

The series showcases the relentless pursuit of perfection as the designers face numerous obstacles, including blizzards, dangerous roads, and a rapidly ticking clock. From fraught deliveries and icy conditions to the custom designs required for the new space, every step of the renovation is pressure-filled. But the two are no stranger to adversity and are determined to overcome delays, unpredictable weather and their own demanding personalities.

name: Wynne's Welsh 80s
summary: Radio Wales's Wynne Evans and his dog Ginny delve into the BBC Wales archives of the 1980s to share memorable moments, music and nostalgia.

name: Factice
summary: Victoire is a medical secretary and part-time graphic designer. She lives a quiet life in the suburbs with her husband, two teenagers, and her brother, who stays in a cabin in their backyard. But when her husband is badly injured at work, Victoire discovers they are drowning in debt. She hides a secret from her past, a talent : a gift for forgery that once got her into serious trouble in her youth. Desperate to avoid financial ruin, she teams up with her brother to start a forgery business. While thrilling at first, their operation soon attracts the attention of real criminals, including the dangerous and mysterious Edith.

name: Une belle histoire
summary: Love, secrets, and unexpected twists—meet the couples navigating the unpredictable journey of romance in this lively drama. Following the intertwined, rhythmic paths of three couples—three men and three women—exploring the pursuit of happiness in youth and balance in later years.

name: Sad Power
summary: After an ordinary group of people gain superpowers in a car accident, they come together to help society and one another with their issues.

name: Wynne's Welsh 90s
summary:
Join TV and radio presenter Wynne Evans as he explores the BBC Wales archives of the 1990s.

From surprisingly relatable political issues to highlights of sport, culture and daily life, the series takes a nostalgic stroll through the ‘90s, with a mix of classic BBC footage and family films from Wynne's own personal archives.

name: Mysteries of...
summary: Deep dives into iconic sites and phenomena across the planet. Mysterious places that hold a powerful grip over the collective imagination, where myths and secrets abound.

name: Kral Kaybederse
summary: The series tells how a hunter who thinks that he will not go down from the peaks falls prey to his prey, and how an unhappy woman who has convinced herself that she will not be loved becomes a hunter in her tragic life.

name: Enamorándonos
summary:
Enamorándonos is a live dating/matchmaking format that was originally popularized in Turkey. The show brings people from all walks of life together for one common purpose: to find love! Love is in the air has encouraged and coached countless couples seeking rewarding relationships and happy homes since its debut.

Candidates who are looking to find their perfect match apply to the show and join the live studio show. The viewers at home who are interested in knowing these candidates call into the studio to meet them. At the studio, they meet for the first time on a blind date, and talk through an automated wall. Hopefully, there is a spark once the wall is withdrawn. But if not, the candidate goes back to the show to continue looking for true love.

name: For The Fellas
summary: For The Fellas has become a cultural touchpoint, providing Black men with a safe and authentic space to engage in raw, unfiltered conversations. From the entertainment world's rising stars to established icons, the series highlights diverse perspectives and showcases the power of storytelling in fostering connection and understanding.

name: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
summary: When winter slams into the highways of the American Rockies, heavy recovery specialists from four companies race into action, working to clear wrecks and open roads. Whether it's a raging fire or toxic spill, crews roll up ready to battle the wreckage. They've got the equipment and the skills. But with more than a million people depending on the route that crosses these three states every day, the one thing they don't have, is time.

name: Leopardi: Il Poeta Dell'Infinito
summary: Showcases the life of Giacomo Leopardi, an Italian poet known for his melancholic verses on fleeting happiness, existentialism, and human suffering.

name: The Potato Lab
summary: In The Potato Lab, Mi Kyung's potato-centric life is upended by Baek Ho, a cold pragmatist. A whirlwind healing romantic comedy unfolds, as twisty as a tornado potato.

name: Когда на юг улетят журавли
summary: Irina Egorova works as a school teacher and raises her daughter alone. One day, Liza feels ill in kindergarten and is taken to the hospital. After an examination, it turns out that the girl has a heart defect and needs an expensive operation.

name: Жар
summary: Star chef Mark Levinsky is being fired from a top restaurant in the capital due to his insistence. Moreover, now no one from the restaurant business wants to deal with him. The only way out is to open your own place with an aspiring chef, Aaron, whom Mark has known for the first day, and put all this metropolitan tinsel under your belt. In search of investors, the newly minted colleagues find themselves in debt to the Serbian mafia and are now forced to protect themselves and their loved ones.

name: Nails
summary: Nails tells the story of Lina, Vanessa, Irene and Marilís, four women from different backgrounds and of different ages who meet in a nail salon. Their repeated encounters spark a unique friendship, turning them into partners in crime and influencing the most important decision of their lives: to rebel against their reality and reject who they have become. What happened to their right to choose? Are they victims of what is expected of them? This non-conformism, paired with a feeling of sisterhood, leads the protagonists to create ‘The Free Women's Club' - a safe space intended to help other women solve their problems.

name: The Real Unforgotten
summary:
ITV's acclaimed drama series Unforgotten fictionalises a modern-day police team investigating cold case murders and gradually unravelling long-forgotten secrets.

Now this new programme from the BAFTA - and multi-award-winning Brinkworth Productions delivers the real thing - with full access to the investigation for the last six years, this series follows a police unit as they bring one of the most intractable murder cases from the past to justice. Just like the drama, the officers never forget that at the core of a murder investigation is the saddest human tragedy.

Completely embedded in the unit, the programmes witness the case as it unfolds in front of us - we are there as detectives pick their way through the dead ends and frail memories to discover the truth; we are with them as they target and arrest the suspects; we are in the room as they plan the whole interrogation process, including how they tackle the lies and inconsistencies they have found. Stage by stage and hour by hour, we see every major step of the way as justice is finally served.

In what may be potentially a first, the films have access not just to the whole police investigation, but also their meetings with the CPS and with their King's Counsel as they discuss how and when to get the suspects to charge and court.

Taking viewers inside a world where no crime is truly forgotten - and no stone is left unturned - this series is truly The Real Unforgotten.

name: Slayers: Wheel of Fate
summary: Slayers: Wheel of Fate follows 10 queer competitors as they embark on an "immersive gaming experience." This show is going to take place inside a mysterious castle. Good reality TV happens inside castles.

name: Flirt Milk
summary: Nomjuet joins the photography club and meets Phra-ek a junior who likes to keep a beard and dresses untidily. One day, Phra-ek brings his favorite camera to help Nomjuet take pictures, but Nomjuet accidentally drops it, rendering it unusable. To repay the camera debt, Nomjuet has to work at Milk Bear Cafe.

name: The Hot Spot
summary: Endo Kiyomi is a single mother living in a town at the foot of Mt. Fuji in Yamanashi Prefecture. She works at a business hotel. One day, she happens to meet an alien. If she was a pure-hearted girl, she would probably try to develop a friendship with the alien and fight against injustice in the world, but she's a little different. As an adult, she has experienced good and bad in the world. She asks the alien to solve minor events at her work or in her personal life without upsetting the alien.

name: Ikiru Toka Shinu Toka Chichioya Toka
summary: Tokiko's mother died 20 years ago and her father Tetsuya is now in his 70's. Her father has a free spirit and is cute. Tokiko is in her mid 40's and still single. She has a strong personality. In their past, Tokiko and Tetsuya did not have a good relationship. It got so bad that they almost ended their relationship, but now they occasionally meet. They go out to eat together and have conversations. Tokiko decides to publish an essay about her father Tetsuya. To collect information for her essay, she meets Tetsuya and listens to various stories, but it's not just pleasant memories.

name: Зовите Витю!
summary:
Vitya, a young charlatan psychic, has a gift for scamming desperate people out of their money. While his conversations with "ghosts of the dead" provide him with a luxurious lifestyle, Vitya's conscience remains silent.
However, luck cannot last forever, and Vitya is approached by Sasha, a blogger who aspires to expose him. However, it seems that the "psychic" has begun to see spirits for real. Vitya doesn't quite understand what to do with the ghosts that have fallen on his head, but Sasha does. Now she has a real chance to create a sensational video.

name: Дыши
summary: Lera is a sought-after obstetrician who works with the most prestigious patients, but her personal life has become unbearably difficult. After her husband's death, she is forced to raise three children alone. Despite this, Lera copes equally well both as a mother and as an obstetrician. But at some point, she still loses control over herself, which becomes one of the reasons for the tragedy during the birth of an important client. Now Lera can lose everything: her family, her job, and even her freedom. Will she be able to find the strength to revive her life without letting what is dear to her fall apart?

name: Высокий сезон
summary: The couple's vacation began on the paradisiacal beaches of Vietnam. But how will it end? Season 1 of the TV series "High Season" can be watched online. On the eve of leaving home, Misha and Anya's plans are unexpectedly interfered with. The girl meets her ex — and, as she thought, dead — boyfriend Sasha Sakhar, and soon after disappears. The police refuse to help Misha in the search for his beloved. His own investigation leads him to the captain of the People's Army of Vietnam, whose name is Tao. She is also trying to get the truth out of others about a personal tragedy — the death of her younger sister. The search for the culprits draws Tao and Misha into the cycle of the city's nightlife, full of carefully hidden secrets and deadly danger.

name: Ai No Kisetsu
summary: After Tokyo, feelings changed, but questions remained. A year later, P thrived as a blogger, Pan and Plai as singers ... until Pan returned to Japan, not alone. Can P turn this winter into a Season of Love?

name: Culpables: London
summary: When Noah's mother, Ella, falls in love with the very wealthy William, the two move from America to London to live with William and his son Nick. Upon arrival, the 18-year-old Noah meets bad boy Nick, and there is an immediate attraction between the two. Noah spends the summer adjusting to her new life, making new friends from Nick's various circles, and navigating a complicated relationship with him while they fight to keep the attraction at bay. Noah will ultimately be forced to deal with her devastating past while falling in love for the first time.

name: Brunch with Tiffany
summary: Tiffany Pollard gathers around the tables of New York City's hottest restaurants with her famous friends for free-flowing conversations and cocktails.

name: The X Change Rate
summary: Talk-show hosted by celebrity Drag-Queen Monét X Change with artist and celebrity guests.

name: CBC Newsroom with Marianne Dimain
summary: Marianne Dimain brings Canadians the latest breaking news and live coverage from across Canada and around the world.

name: След Чикатило
summary: In the early 2000s, southern Russia was rocked by a series of horrific attacks on the Don highway and other roads. Detectives are on the trail of a gang of "Amazons" led by the mysterious Smallpox. Detectives will have to rescue the hostages and stop the criminals, as well as find out how the girls are connected to the Chikatilo case.

name: CBC Newsroom with Natasha Fatah
summary:
Natasha Fatah brings Canadians the latest breaking news and live coverage from across Canada and around the world.

Sat. 11 a.m. - 4 p.m. ET

Sun. 12 - 4 p.m. ET

name: Katie Price: Making Babies
summary: Series following the media personality as she and her partner at the time, Carl, undergo IVF treatment in the hope of growing their family.

name: How Dare You!?
summary:
Workplace rookie Wang Cuihua unexpectedly finds herself inside the plot of a transmigration novel, where she meets Zhang San, another time-traveler. One is a novice struggling to fight against fate in the workplace; the other is a domineering king who has spent ten years lying low, hiding his achievements. Together, the two, armed with knowledge of the script, begin a series of strategic maneuvers to survive. Tests confirm that the secondary female character, Xie Yong'er, is a transmigrator from an even lower level of the story world. Wang Cuihua and Zhang San prepare drought-resistant crops in advance, recruit talented individuals, stabilize the borderlands, and win over Xie Yong'er, all while defeating the Duke of Duan. Victory seems within reach, but Xiahou Dan (Zhang San) suffers from a long-term, incurable head illness. Only then does Yu Wanyin (Wang Cuihua) realize that the anonymous guest had long prophesied that only one of them could survive. Back when Xiahou Dan spared her life, he missed his best chance to survive. Now, Yu Wanyin makes the same choice to save Xiahou Dan. The weak Qiang Kingdom frequently sends assassins to defeat the Great Xia. When a mute assassin attempts to poison Xiahou Dan, Yu Wanyin uses poison to counter poison, curing his head illness and saving his life. In the end, Yu Wanyin and Xiahou Dan both survive, witnessing the prosperous era they had worked so hard to achieve.

Adapted from the novel of the same name by Qi Yingjun.

name: The Roshans
summary: Soulful compositions. Box-office hits. A timeless legacy. This documentary series traces the lives of the Roshans and their unforgettable work.

name: Melo Movie
summary: Even if hardship and misfortune always accompany life, the youths who have walked with their middle finger raised now seek someone to lean on wholeheartedly, wanting to find a person to rely on as if they were to fall. Dreaming of becoming a film director one day, Kim Moo Bi, an assistant director, wants to follow in her father's footsteps, who worked as a filming crew member. After entering the film industry, she quietly honed her skills, not drawing attention to herself in the eyes of others. On the other hand, Ko Gyeom rose from being a supporting actor to becoming a film critic. He meets Moo Bi on the set of an interview film, eventually starting their own love story.

previousepisode.name: Life is a Beautiful, Magnificent Thing, Even to a Jellyfish

name: Laochra Gael
summary: The definitive GAA sports series returns to TG4 for a 23rd series. The series' hour-long format has proven a huge success, bringing each player's personal stories to the screen. The series features eight Laochra with star quality and reveals deeper, fresh and sometimes genuine unexpected insights into the lives of these icons. While their sporting careers continue to provide the backdrop to the story, the series travels well beyond the four white lines. Gripping personal stories will compel viewers to travel towards the territory unique to the GAA television landscape.

name: Олдскул
summary: Maria Trifonova is a real "old—school" mathematician, the last "Teacher of the Year of the USSR". In her lessons, children are not only afraid to reach for their phones, but they don't even breathe without permission. Unexpectedly, the heroine finds herself in an elite school — all for the chance to establish a relationship with her only granddaughter, whom she has not seen for many years due to a conflict with her daughter. In her new world, Maria will face an unusual approach to learning: freedom, technology, and the spoiled children of the rich reign here. Now the "Soviet teacher" will have to instill a love of mathematics in the modern generation and find a common language with the closest people.

name: Good Luck Guys Norge
summary: Good Luck Guys, where the location is idyllic, the personalities are BIG, the suitability is low, and where the humor and drama are loose!

name: Happy New Year, MacarMo
summary: Lu Xiaomu, the inheritor of the intangible cultural heritage of Huamomo, and Ren Yaqi, a pastry chef who returned from abroad, unexpectedly reunite through a series of comical blind dates. Together, they create the MacarMo, a fusion of Eastern and Western flavors. As their fake relationship turns into real affection, they find a harmonious balance between tradition and innovation, while also discovering love and chasing their dreams together.

name: Ready, Set, Glow!
summary: Wes Brown visits the most spectacular holiday light displays in the USA, and gets to know the families and communities behind them.

name: How to Win the Champions League
summary: The secrets of success. Locker room tales from Real Madrid's revolution, Liverpool's 2019 title run and Jose Mourinho's triumphs reveal what it takes to be crowned kings of Europe.

name: FC Soldout
summary: FC Soldout is about a soccer team that is not doing well, one day it is bought by a agency, the reason for the acquisition is just to commoditize the team to make money again, the agency takes over and cuts out all the players with poor face，then forces the actors with face value from their agency to become players.

name: Kick Kick Kick Kick
summary: A comedy-drama about a star story that takes place in establishing and running a new content production company by an entertainment producer and a once-popular actor.

name: Her Sport Awards
summary: Highlights from the Her Sport Awards from UCD which recognised and celebrated the incredible achievements of Irish athletes. 2024 has been a landmark year for Irish sportswomen.

name: Timpeall na Tíre
summary: Some of the stories from this week's regional news as seen on Nuacht TG4.

name: Réalta agus Gaolta
summary: The search for Ireland's most talented family begins. Hosted by Síomha Ní Ruairc, the best singing, dancing and musical families the nation has to offer will compete against each other, all vying to be crowned the most talented family in Ireland!

name: Barrett-Jackson LIVE Auction
summary: The only view better than the water and sand is the sight of the cars rolling down the block at this year's Barrett-Jackson auction. Tune in for collector cars that are out of this world as Barrett-Jackson lands in Scottsdale, Arizona. Barrett-Jackson is in Scottsdale with some of the best cars the auction has seen yet. From collector classics to modern marvels, Scottsdale has it all.

name: Scoil Cheoil an Earraigh
summary: New music series, Scoil Cheoil an Earraigh, comes from the traditional music festival Scoil Cheoil an Earraigh 2024 on the Dingle Peninsula.

name: Oíche i gCorcaigh
summary: This documentary series is set in Cork over one night. What happens when dusk falls and the evening opens out ahead?

name: Seven's National News at Noon
summary:
Seven's National News at Noon will deliver viewers breaking news and updates from Australia and abroad.

From finance and health to consumer affairs and property, the new bulletin will also include interactive panel chats, special reports and feature segments on the stories that matter to all Australians from 7NEWS' national news desk and team of reporters

name: Siar Linn
summary: How was life in the olden days? What did they eat? How did they play? And eh... where did they go to the toilet...!? Welcome to Siar Linn, the game show where we explore a different era of history with tasks and challenges. Our History Squad plays 'Siar Linn' by exploring this era with the help of their 'Adventure Avatars'! The aim of the game? Win as many gold badges as possible.

name: Mo Pheata
summary: 'Mo Pheata' is a series about young people and their pets. Our presenters Séaghan and Faith Leigh will meet with young people and their pets from all over the country. They'll have lots of fun as their pets compete and learn how to care for their own pets at home.

name: In the Valley of Sin
summary: Explores the harrowing claims of child abuse in the sleepy town of Wenatchee, WA. In 1995, the wholesome "Apple Capital of the World" was rocked by appalling allegations that adults in the town were running a child sex trafficking ring dubbed "The Circle," which abused more than 60 children at various locations around the town. After dozens of arrests, more than 29,000 counts of child abuse and 1,000 combined hours of prison sentences, the truth emerged: None of it ever happened.

name: AC360 Later
summary: Hosted by Anderson Cooper

name: Britney sans filtre
summary: What happened to the pop princess? Perfect incarnation of the American dream and its excesses, Britney Spears appears to be the guinea pig of modern celebrity. In five episodes, this documentary series retraces the trajectory of the first pop star of the 21st century and reveals the workings of a spectacle society which is running on empty, fueled by the gaze of us all.

name: L'Inde fantôme
summary: Louis Malle called his gorgeous and groundbreaking Phantom India the most personal film of his career. And this extraordinary journey to India, originally shown as a miniseries on European television, is infused with his sense of discovery, as well as occasional outrage, intrigue, and joy.

name: Aventura en pelotas: España
summary: Five pairs of strangers face 21 days isolated in the Colombian jungle, confronted with nature's greatest dangers - and completely naked.

name: Síorstíl
summary: Síorstíl is a cutting-edge sustainable fashion competition where six talented designers transform second-hand clothes and recycled materials into high fashion editorial garments. Over the course of six episodes, our contestants face a series of challenges in a bid to become Síorstíl champion.

name: Gradaim an Uachtaráin
summary: The volunteer is the heart and soul of the GAA. The prestigious President's Award is presented to 11 volunteers every year for their long-standing commitment and dedication in their respective field within the GAA.

name: Cispheil Bheo
summary: Live basketball coverage.

name: De Valera San Fhásach
summary:
A new documentary will tell the story of Éamon de Valera's wilderness years from 1924 to 1926, and of the strong women who supported him – but would ultimately be betrayed.

The programme, titled De Valera san Fhásach, will show the political leader being imprisoned, in poor mental health and stripped of his political power. It will also depict the radical, revolutionary women activists who stood by him during this difficult time.

name: Лошадь Пржевальского
summary: The characters of the sketchcom are intelligent, reflective, sweet and funny characters, through which ironic meanings are conveyed. The show in the spirit of old British sketches, but in a new manner, will make you smile and reflect on the subtleties of existence.

name: Inheritance Detective
summary: A former elite lawyer turned private detective, he specializes in solving complex inheritance cases. Operating his own office, he uses his intelligence and the help of eccentric allies to uncover hidden truths and resolve family conflicts. A coffee enthusiast with a dislike for the phrase "Dead men tell no tales," he respects the deceased's will while seeking justice.

name: Order Up With Hudson Yang
summary: Fresh in the kitchen, Hudson needs to beef up his culinary foundations. Starting in his own back yard of Los Angeles, California - he must learn the skills needed to kickstart his culinary adventure.

name: De Oranjezondag
summary: Hélène Hendriks, assisted by regular sidekick Rutger Castricum, receives different guests every week and talks to them about current affairs.

name: Colombia's Wild Coast
summary: One of the most diverse countries on Earth, Colombia's two stunning coasts provide a remarkable variety of life. See the magnificent creatures that live below the waves and on the beaches.

name: Street Food Nomad: Kolkata
summary: Chef Will Meyrick embarks on an exciting journey through Kolkata's vibrant street food scene.

name: Cycling: National Road Championships
summary: Highlights from the Cycling: National Road Championships.

previousepisode.name: Cycling: National Road Championships 2025: Men's Highlights

name: Women's Weekly Football
summary: Highlights from Women's football.

name: Eating with the Enemy
summary: Home cooks compete to impress four of the country's toughest and most feared food critics.

name: Eating with the Enemy
summary: Complete strangers with opposite perspectives on a variety of topics share a meal together under the observation of psychology and human behaviour experts.

name: Being Pampered During Pregnancy
summary: A girl who lives a difficult life but strives for self-improvement met and fell in love with the indifferent CEO Fu Xuan Yi. Fu Xuan Yi's favor freed Wei Yu Xian from the shackles of her family, and the two finally lived happily together.

name: Surviving Black Hawk Down
summary: Surviving Black Hawk Down tells the gripping real story of the horror and heroism behind the events that inspired Ridley Scott's blockbuster movie Black Hawk Down, blending raw, immersive storytelling with first-person interviews from both sides of The Battle of Mogadishu.

name: Usotoki Rhetoric
summary: It is 1926, the first year of the Showa era. Urabe Kanoko has left her hometown after it turns against her for having the ability to hear lies when spoken. She collapses from hunger after arriving in a town called Tsukumoya, where she meets a poverty-stricken detective named Iwai Souma. Is this fate? Or something more?

name: For Eagle Brothers
summary: The story of the eldest sister-in-law, who becomes the breadwinner after her husband's sudden death 10 days after marriage, and five brothers with a brewery that has been manufacturing traditional liquor for three generations.

name: Friendly Rivalry
summary:
Woo Seul-Ki grew up in an orphanage out in a province. She moves to Seoul and enrolls in Chaehwa High School, which is a school for the top 1% students in South Korea. Woo Seul-Ki doesn't get along with the other students. A student named Yoo Je-Yi approaches her and they become friends.

Yoo Je-Yi is the most powerful student in the school. She has a high IQ, comes from a wealthy family background, and is attractive physically. She has lived as the envy of other people since she was born and she is aware of her superiority. She is also cunning enough to know how to take advantage of her position. She shows special interest in transfer student Woo Seul-Ki. They soon develop a dangerous relationship between friendship and obsession.

name: American Manhunt: O.J. Simpson
summary: The white Bronco. The gloves. The trial of the century. This documentary series investigates the shocking murder case that became a cultural phenomenon.

name: Röda mattan eller renar?
summary: What happens when one of Sápmi's and Norway's biggest influencers and celebrities, Erlend Elias Bragstad, questions his entire family history? In the reality series Röda mattan or reindeer? he leaves his glamorous red-carpet life to find out if he really is the same - or if everything was just a family crown he and half the family have passed on.

previousepisode.name: Det är så härligt att äntligen komma till ro

name: Juffrou X
summary: A teacher at a struggling school is devastated by the death of her star pupil at the hands of a criminal ex-boyfriend. She accidentally avenges the murder, and quickly finds herself.

name: Fynskrif
summary: A law firm in South Africa takes on various cases, while the partners and associates need to balance their personal lives and keep the firm alive.

name: Plan B
summary: The story of a man with a military background, Ivan Malan, and his partner, Paul Schmidt, who plan and carry out a theft from a gang boss. The prize is the Flame Girl - a painting by the master painter Vermeer that is worth EUR30 million.

name: Wo die Liebe hinfällt – Jedes Paar ist anders

previousepisode.name: Der Kampf mit Distanz und Gefängnis

name: Heart Stain
summary:
"Let's date until we graduate."

Woohyun has a secret crush on his homeroom teacher. His best friend, Doha, finds out and confesses his feelings for him. But then he makes an interesting proposition: "Go out with me. Fall for me before graduation, and I win. If you don't, you win." Can Woohyun like someone other than his teacher?

name: I Fratelli Corsaro
summary: In the unique and inimitable setting of the city of Palermo, the Corsaro brothers move. Fabrizio is a black journalist, Roberto is a criminal lawyer: for this reason they often find themselves forced to work on the same case. Impulsive and libertine Fabrizio, precise and calm Roberto, despite the constant bickering, will be able to solve even the most difficult of mysteries.

name: Canada Tonight
summary: For a bold voice in journalism and a fresh perspective on the daily news cycle, watch Canada Tonight. Live

name: Mo Fang You Xi Zhi Zui Sha
To Love or To Defy
summary: Killer Di Shiqi disguises herself as a princess sent for a political marriage to enter the palace to carry out an assassination. By fate, she meets the Fifth Prince, Ouyang Shao, and falls in love with him. However, her master holds her family hostage and forces her to kill the prince. Torn between the inescapable mission and undeniable love, they decide to fight against destiny only to stay with each other.

name: Беременна по обману
summary:
"Pregnant by Deception" is the first reality show about women who became victims of deception by married men.
They hoped for a strong and long relationship, their lovers promised them a reliable family. And now, after getting pregnant by their beloved man, they find out the truth - their man is married and leads a double life.

name: The Takedown: American Aryans
summary: The Takedown: American Aryans takes viewers inside the cult-like world of the Aryan Brotherhood of Texas from the late 2000s to the present day. Told principally by charismatic federal agent Richard Boehning, the series examines an organized crime group built on Nazi ideology and extreme violence operating under the radar in the suburbs of Texas. The shocking murder of a young woman catapults Boehning and his Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF) task force on an odyssey to protect American values against an enemy growing in confidence and power.

name: Eyes on the Prize III: We Who Believe in Freedom Cannot Rest 1977-2015
summary:
Inspired by Henry Hampton's legendary documentary series "Eyes on the Prize: America's Civil Rights Movement," this new installment of the groundbreaking 1987 series illuminates the bold stories of people and communities who continue to work for equity and racial justice in the years since the birth of the American civil rights movement.

This new chapter of the iconic series begins in the late 1970s and continues into 2015, with episodes examining the strategies of those who fought for racial equality across multiple decades. As in the original production, diverse teams of acclaimed filmmakers bring each story to life by showcasing the work of citizens in an ever-more multicultural society working to achieve true equity.

name: De Wereld van Luiten
summary: All new series coming up on the channel in February. De Wereld van Luiten takes you behind the scenes with the Luiten family as we follow up and coming Dutch Dressage superstar Marten Luiten on his way to the top. Real life, entertaining and informative.

name: Masters of Reinvention
summary:
In this new six-part UKTV Original series, award-winning mechanical engineer, Dr Shini Somara, will turn to back copies of Practical Mechanics magazine - once the best-selling bible of British inventors -and challenge a dream design team to reinvent its vintage blueprints for the 21st century.

Each week, Dr Shini will lead a diverse crew of engineers, crafters and gadgeteers as they try to update these vintage designs from the 30s, 40s and 50s and make them fit for purpose in the modern world.

Working from a vintage shed on a Yorkshire airfield, the build teams will be drawn from a pool of returning experts, with Dr Shini allocating team members to the projects that most suits their skills.

The reinvention challenges range from a build-at-home car, a boat and a camping trailer…to a pedal-powered washing machine, a burglar alarm and a lie detector.

They've set themselves just four weeks - the time between each edition of the magazine – in which to design and build them.Filled with imaginative and ambitious designs - and combining old-fashioned DIY skills with clever modern technology - the series aims to re-ignite the nation's passion for innovation.

name: The Z-Suite
summary: Advertising maven Monica Marks and her loyal right hand executive Doug Garcia have long been at the top of the Madison Avenue world. But after a record scratch blunder, they are suddenly canceled, pushed out and replaced by the agency's rising Gen Z employees led by social media manager, Kriska Thompson. Refusing to go quietly, Monica launches her biggest campaign yet – getting their careers back and taking down the eager team of Gen-Zers who are just getting comfortable in their new roles. May the best generation win.

name: Help me Buy a Home
summary: Fronted by Buyers Agent Liz O'Kane, Help me Buy a Home unpacks the unfiltered realities Irish people face in the search for a home. Following real life experiences, this series takes a raw and honest look at the emotional rollercoaster, challenges, and hard-won joys of buying a home in Ireland.

name: The Road to War
summary: Eight country-by-country accounts of the origins of the Second World War written and narrated by Charles Wheeler.

name: Зов русалки
summary: A series of murders are occurring in a small town. They have a mystical, ritualistic nature. The investigation reaches a dead end, and locals say a mermaid, the subject of many legends, is to blame. Yuri Bakhtin, a specialist in serial killers, is sent from Moscow to assist the investigation. He doesn't believe in mermaids, but the more he immerses himself in the case, the more he begins to doubt the veracity of his beliefs. In addition to the investigation, Bakhtin must also deal with family issues. It turns out he lived in this town many years ago, and not only has old friends there, but also his ex-wife. As the investigation progresses, the list of suspects only grows, including people close to Bakhtin. Navigating the law, family problems, and obstacles from the antagonist, Bakhtin tracks down the killer.

name: Таганрог
summary: KGB officer Viktor Shvets is sent to occupied Taganrog, where he must organize and lead intelligence and the underground. Shvets gets a job in the occupation authorities under the guise of a Volga German, Gustav Schwartz. Thanks to his actions, the underground movement grows to hundreds of people: they commit sabotage, distribute leaflets, save Soviet prisoners of war and prepare an armed uprising. The Gestapo tries with all its might to expose the participants, captures underground members and tortures them, but the resistance of the Taganrog residents only grows.

name: Крестоносцы
summary: Konstantin Krestosotsev heads a group that solves mysterious crimes. Under his command are the charming psychologist Masha and the forensic expert Morozov, a firm believer in mysticism. Well versed in esotericism and occultism, Krusosotsev is confident that cases from his practice have a rational explanation - be it the living dead or the deadly curse of a famous psychic. However, soon the hero will have to face something truly incredible.

name: Goldie
summary: Follow Goldie, a giant girl with a big heart, as she sets off on epic adventures with her best friends in their beloved town of Boysenberg. Together, they learn that being different is something to celebrate, and that there's space for everyone in this world — even giants.

name: Duck Dynasty: The Revival
summary: Duck Dynasty: The Revival centers on Willie and Korie Robertson as they navigate life with their growing family of adult children and grandchildren, now part of the next generation carrying on the Robertson legacy at their Louisiana homestead. As the family business expands beyond ducks, Willie and Korie bring their signature wit and down-home charm while they explore the future of Duck Commander, support their children through marriage, parenthood, and entrepreneurship, and work to keep their legacy alive. However, Willie quickly realizes that this next generation isn't as Robertson as he originally thought.

name: The Carters: Hurts To Love You
summary: The Carters follows bona fide American teen heartthrobs, Nick and Aaron, who seemed to have it all, but behind their remarkable gifts was a family dealing with mental health struggles, drug addiction, and heartbreaking neglect. Their story is told by Aaron's twin sister, Angel, who unpacks the complicated family dynamics that led to the untimely deaths of three of the original five Carter kids as well as their father. The often enchanting but ultimately painful story of these engaging siblings begins in childhood as home movies reveal Nick and Aaron's undeniable and precocious talent. But fame and fortune were accompanied by rivalries, jealousies, and exploitation from those they relied on most, their parents. It is a sad and eye-opening tale shared by Angel and close family friends who also live in the spotlight including Melissa Joan Hart and Scout Willis. The film features exclusive interviews with those closest to the family, some who have never spoken out before.

name: No Taste Like Home with Antoni Porowski
summary: No Taste Like Home with Antoni Porowski invites viewers on a captivating culinary adventure. Antoni Porowski — joined by celebrity guests Awkwafina, Henry Golding, James Marsden, Florence Pugh, Issa Rae and Justin Theroux — curates bespoke journeys that uncover the rich stories behind treasured family recipes. From the mouthwatering origins of Theroux's family pasta in Italy to the vibrant flavors of Awkwafina's Korean heritage, each episode celebrates the deep connections between food, culture and identity. As they explore the world together, Antoni and his guests meet locals who share their own family traditions and culinary secrets. Each journey culminates in a heartfelt family meal featuring a regional classic, showcasing the beauty and diversity of their cultural heritage. From dining with royalty to off-road adventures, No Taste Like Home is filled with heartwarming moments, bold flavors, and surprising revelations that offer a delicious glimpse into the stories that shape us all.

name: A muerte
summary: A muerte tells the story of the cautious Raúl, who reconnects with free-spirited and newly pregnant Marta, following his heart cancer diagnosis. They resume a friendship that began in childhood, and in a relationship brought together by fate, begin to test their beliefs about love. Can the commitment-phobic Marta fall in love? And can Raúl meet the love of his life?

name: A menina que matou os pais - A serie
summary: The mini-series shows Suzane von Richthofen and Daniel Cravinhos' versions about their relationship, their motives and the shocking crime that took place on the night of October 31st 2002. Based on the proceedings of the trial, the story transits from narrative to the testimonies given at court, and further still, interviews with the cast, the Director and the criminologist and script writer.

name: The Love School
summary: London, 1851. The industrial revolution is changing the city. Bringing vivid colour in amongst the dirty red bricks and smoke stacks of the noisy bustling streets are four young, thrill-seeking, outspoken and audaciously creative mavericks John Millais, Dante Gabriel Rossetti, William Holman Hunt and Thomas Woolner otherwise known as the Brotherhood. Championed by the most famous art critic of the time, John Ruskin, the artists are also joined by sassy, sexy model Lizzie Siddal. Their quest for artistic immortality takes them into some of the most debauched, darkest and liveliest corners of the city.

name: CIA
summary: CIA centers on two unlikely partners — a fast-talking, rule-breaking loose cannon CIA case officer, and a by-the-book, seasoned and smart FBI agent who believes in the rule of law. When this odd couple are assigned to work out of CIA's New York Station, they must learn to work together to investigate cases and criminals posing threats on U.S. soil, finding that their differences may actually be their strength.

name: Court of Gold
summary: For the first time ever, top medal contenders in men's basketball granted behind-the-scenes access at the Olympic Games Paris 2024. Court of Gold gives an unfiltered, insider look at Team USA, France, Serbia and Canada as they gear up and battle for gold in Paris. International basketball has caught up to the U.S. and the competition and stakes are higher than ever.

name: Lies Never Lie
summary: Psychologist Li Mochou joins the Baizhou Public Security Bureau, giving Captain Ding Wei a powerful edge. With her criminal profiling skills, Ding Wei leads his team in solving a series of mysterious cases. As they dig deeper, the real mastermind behind a major unsolved case from years ago is finally exposed, bringing long-buried truths to light.

name: The Tucker Carlson Show
summary: The most interesting people in the world join Tucker in his home.

previousepisode.name: Rep. Thomas Massie: Battling the Treachery of Trump's Republican Party, AIPAC, and the Epstein Class

name: Early Start
summary: The news you need, first thing. Rahel Solomon has you covered with the latest headlines.

name: The Arena with Kasie Hunt
summary: Kasie Hunt brings key players into the arena for sharp analysis and panel discussion on the latest news in politics and culture.

name: Calleja en el Espacio
summary: Calleja en el Espacio, will follow renowned explorer and presenter Jesús Calleja in his most ambitious adventure to date: becoming the first Spanish civilian to travel to space.

name: Burden of Guilt
summary: Based on the hit podcast of the same name, Burden of Guilt follows Tracyraquel Berns' emotional journey to unravel the convoluted excuses that were given about her baby brother Matthew's sudden death when she was just two years old. Though initially ruled an accident, the mystery of how Matthew died haunts Tracyraquel throughout her childhood. After years of lies and unanswered questions, she obtains Matthew's medical records and uncovers a shocking detail; she learned she was blamed for his death. Tracyraquel embarks on a relentless search to expose the darkest and deepest secret of her troubled family. Her investigation leads the authorities in Dekalb County Georgia to an unprecedented decision to exhume Matthew's body 25 years after his death, which reveals that his death was a homicide.

name: Planet Weird
summary:
Planet Weird is a quirky, light-hearted celebration of the planet's most bizarre creatures in the animal kingdom. 

Along with witty, tongue-in-cheek narration, by renowned UK comic Ross Noble, the series plays with pop culture, graphics, and human comparisons to make the absolute extremities of nature leap right off the screen and into the modern world. In short, digestible stories, viewers meet the critters who are faster than a speeding bullet, and more powerful than a locomotive. But inside every moment of ‘weird' is a revelation of cleverness, amazing adaptation and scientific surprise.

name: Canada Reads
summary: Ali Hassan will host a panel of celebrity advocates championing Canadian books that speak to this year's theme, "One Book to Change the Narrative." Each day of the competition, one book will be eliminated by the panellists until a winner is declared Canada's must-read book in 2025.

name: Fateful Planet
summary: This 5-part documentary series reconstructs major events that shaped our world and shows how life evolved—despite apocalyptic catastrophes.

name: Incredible Northern Vets
summary: Follow the busy daily lives of three Indigenous veterinarians at unique clinics across three provinces. Each vet serves a wide range of clients and pets with services ranging from animal acupuncture to behavioral expertise for pet anxiety. All three vets are fueled by their love for animals, putting their skills to the test every day by keeping the human/animal bond strong between owners and pets.

name: Historically Haunted Cape Cod
summary: This documentary series explores Cape Cod's ghostly locations through interviews, historical narratives, photographs, videos, and brief reenactments.

name: Stick
summary: Pryce Cahill is an over-the-hill, ex-pro golfer whose career was derailed prematurely 20 years ago. After the collapse of his marriage and getting fired from his job at an Indiana sporting goods store, Pryce hedges his bets, and future, entirely on a troubled 17-year-old golf phenom named Santi. Stick is a heartfelt, feel-good comedy about a found family and their relationships set within the world of golf as it's never been shown before.

name: FC Hollywood: Der FC Bayern und die verrückten 90er
summary: The FC Bayern of the 90s - characterized by guys like Matthäus, Klinsmann, Scholl and Basler - experienced probably the craziest years in the club's history. It was the birth of FC Hollywood.

name: Apocalypse Hotel
summary: The story is set in a solitary hotel in Tokyo's Ginza district in a time when society has collapsed and humanity has disappeared, and nature has begun to reclaim most of the land.

previousepisode.name: Aim to Be the Number One Hotel in the Galaxy

name: Kunon the Sorcerer Can See
summary: Born blind, Kunon aims to be the first person to use water magic to create new eyes for himself. After five months of study, he has already surpassed his teacher, and continues to grow his talents. Not only can his magic help him sense color, but he can also use it to make handy items and even conjure a whole cat! Word of his skills and ingenuity soon reach the court and earn him a spot as disciple to the most powerful magician in the land. But is his ultimate goal even attainable?

name: The Unaware Atelier Master
summary: One day, Kurt, a kind-hearted boy, is suddenly kicked out of the Hero's Party for being "useless". He finds that his aptitude for weapons, magic, and all other combat-related skills is the lowest rank, so he takes odd-jobs repairing the castle walls and digging for minerals to make a living, where his exceptional abilities are immediately revealed. He proves to be skillful in cooking, building, mining, crafting magical tools--in fact, his aptitude for every skill unrelated to combat had an SSS-ranking! Kurt, however, seems completely unaware to his talent and ends up saving people, the town, and even the country through his unaware actions!?

previousepisode.name: A Common Story About How the Former Head of Chores for a Party of Heroes Was Actually SSS-Rank in All Except Combat Skills

name: Love Takes A Village
summary: Love Takes A Village will see singletons go on a series of blind dates with people looking to win a second date. While the two people on the date know they're on a dating show, what they don't know is that the date, which they think is at a restaurant, is actually taking place inside a studio with a live audience watching in secret. At the end of the date, the couple find out who's been watching them.

name: The Will Cain Show
summary: Featuring conversations with newsmakers from across politics, business, culture and sports, The Will Cain Show will offer a comprehensive look at the news of the day in a signature podcast style.

name: Will Cain Country
summary: Join FOX & Friends Weekend host Will Cain as he tackles the latest headlines from his unique perspective along with thought-provoking long-form interviews with leading figures and live calls from viewers and listeners. The Will Cain Show merges the worlds of news and sports, with a spotlight on audience interaction.

name: Confessions of Octomom
summary: Confessions of Octomom follows Suleman as she provides an intimate look at her history and her life today as a mom of 14, and her newest role as a grandmother.  With her octuplets turning sixteen this January and her other six children ranging from 17 to 23 years-old, Suleman has been out of the public eye for years and now, for the first time, Suleman and her 14 children reveal a much different life than the world has ever been privy to before. The series also follows the octuplets through their challenges and triumphs, growing up in the spotlight and their desire to move beyond their now secluded life.

name: Trial & Error: Why Did O.J. Win?
summary: Trial & Error: Why Did O.J. Win? will explore what went right for the defense, what went wrong for the prosecution and the perfect storm of legal strategies and surprises that led to one of the most controversial verdicts in history. The series highlights myriad vantage points from numerous trial participants, including attorneys, legal experts, Los Angeles police detectives and friends and relatives on both sides of the courtroom.

name: Cóyotl, Héroe y Bestia
summary: Cóyotl, Héroe y Bestia tells the story of a Mexican hero who will fight to defend his own and become the guardian that his people need, starting an epic fight between good and evil.

name: William & Harry: Love & Betrayal
summary: Once the golden boys of the monarchy, brothers William and Harry are now at war. This two-part series delves deep into their now-fractured relationship, revealing just when those battle lines were drawn.

name: СучЦукрМуз
summary: On creativity, life and scandals: the most candid music podcast, in which the leader of the band "Hammerman Destroys Viruses" Albert Tsukrenko asks his guests unexpected provocative questions.

previousepisode.name: BRYKULETS про підкаблучників, кредити, Бабкіна і «Євробачення»

name: Buck Denver Asks: What's in the Bible?
summary: The Bible Made Easy! Buck Denver and his friends take your children through the WHOLE Bible. Perfect viewing for the entire family - laugh and learn together. In his first new project since VeggieTales, Phil Vischer has set out to teach kids (and parents!) the story of the Bible – God's great rescue plan! We know the stories of Moses, Noah, David, and Jesus, but in this groundbreaking new series, we learn how they all fit together to tell one big, redemptive story. Vischer's signature wit shines through with his all-new cast of characters, fast-paced flash animation, and catchy tunes. This is one journey through the Bible you won't want to miss!

name: I död och lust
summary: What can drive someone to murder their partner? When does everything go wrong, and why? "In Death and Lust" examines the determining factors behind how a loving relationship can end in murder.

name: Go Back To Where You Came From
summary: What happens when six opinionated Brits with starkly opposed views on immigration confront the harsh realities of refugee life? Dave, a chef from Nottingham; Bushra, a small business owner from Surrey; Chloe, a GB News regular from Cornwall; Nathan, a haulage business owner from Barnsley; Mathilda, a podcaster from London; and Jess, a sports coach from Wales, put their outspoken views on immigration to the ultimate test on a life-changing journey. In Mogadishu in Somalia and Raqqa in Syria, two of the world's most dangerous cities, they're exposed to a life of missile strikes, overcrowded refugee camps, and the crippling poverty endured by millions. Often hiding behind humour, their deeply polarized views on immigration are pushed to breaking point, sparking intense conflicts and shocking revelations. Through Africa, the Middle East and Europe, heading back to the UK, they cross vast deserts, climb treacherous mountain borders, and endure some of the peril of small boat crossings as they uncover the raw truth of how refugees reach Britain, why they risk everything to get here, and what they leave behind. Will this eye-opening journey change their minds on immigration, or will it only strengthen their resolve?

name: George Clarke's Building Home
summary: In this brand-new series, George Clarke meets people who are taking on challenging huge builds for powerful emotional reasons, from being drawn back to an area that they've always loved or a place with strong family memories, to taking on a house that's close to their heart - like historic ruins that need rescuing, or a wreck of a beach house. We follow them as they uproot their lives, stretch their finances and test their relationships, all in order to build wonderful homes of their dreams.

name: Dubai: Buying The Dream
summary: This new reality series is set in a leading Dubai real estate company - where agents chase riches in one of the hottest luxury property markets in the world. A cast of ambitious agents tour some of the city's most jaw-dropping properties, deploying their charm and business savvy to sell to the super-rich as they compete for eye-watering commissions - often £100k for just one sale, all tax-free.

name: Spring Burning
summary: In the 80s, a brilliant university student, Lu Ran, was forced into marriage for money by her uncle and aunt to a rough, poor man with a child! Refusing to let others decide her fate, Lu Ran daringly escapes. But during her escape, she unexpectedly encounters a tall, handsome, and gentle man—who turns out to be her real fiancé?!
